name: timer-frame
title: Timer Frame
description: A countdown drawn around the card's edge: an orange frame drains clockwise as a small comet circles.

perf.budget: The frame drains in one continuous UI-thread timing and the comet is one turning view, so it animates while running. The time re-renders once a second.

a11y.reducedMotion: The frame steps with the clock and the comet holds still.
a11y.screenReader: One timer ("3:37 left", or "3:37 left, paused").

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { TimerFrame } from '@/components/kinetik/timer-frame';

<TimerFrame total={300} start={217} label="BREW" />;
```

## When to use

- Cooking, brewing, workouts and focus sessions.
- Live timers where the time left should read at a glance.

## When not to use

- Long timers: the frame barely moves over hours.
- Exact timing. It runs on the JS clock and is only as precise as a second.

## Notes

- The timer owns its countdown. Remount it with a new `key` to restart.
- Setting `running` to false holds it, and it picks up from the same time.
- `onDone` fires once when the time runs out.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add timer-frame`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
